Jammu-Srinagar Highway Closed Due to Landslides, 26 Reported Dead

The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway has been closed for the third consecutive day due to landslides. Heavy rains in Jammu and Kashmir are cited as the cause for the disruption. Reports indicate that 26 people have died in connection with the events.
